title: Upgrade vulnerable `cryptography` (GHSA-style RCE in OpenSSL bindings)
body: The pinned `cryptography` version is affected by a known advisory in its bundled OpenSSL. Upgrade to the latest patched release and confirm no API usage broke (Fernet, x509 loaders). This is a transitive risk surfaced by the dependency scanner.

title: Upgrade `requests` to patch CVE in connection pooling
body: Dependency scan flags the pinned `requests` version for a security advisory. Bump to the nearest patched version and run the modules that perform outbound HTTP.

title: Replace deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` usages (code quality)
body: Several modules call the deprecated naive `datetime.utcnow()`. Replace with timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` to avoid silent UTC bugs. Scoped, mechanical, well-suited to an autonomous fix with test coverage.

title: Pin and upgrade `Pillow` to address image-parsing advisory
body: Image-handling dependency `Pillow` is below the patched version for a known advisory affecting crafted image parsing. Upgrade and verify thumbnail/screenshot code paths still pass their tests.
